home_community.name: Carlton
home_community.description: Travelers and locals in Carlton and the inner north of Melbourne.
home_community.content: Welcome to the Carlton community! We're hosts, surfers and locals who love meeting people from all over the world. Join us for picnics in Carlton Gardens, language exchanges and our monthly potluck.

users.name: Maya
users.about_me: Designer, slow traveler and enthusiastic home cook. I've surfed on four continents and host whenever my little Carlton apartment allows. Ask me about the best dumplings in Chinatown or where to get a proper flat white.
users.about_place: A cozy one-bedroom near Carlton Gardens with a very comfortable couch and a very opinionated cat.

users.name: Inês
users.about_me: I restore azulejos, Lisbon's painted tiles, in a small workshop in Alfama. I love showing guests the hidden miradouros, sharing a late dinner and swapping travel stories over vinho verde.
users.about_place: A sunny flat at the top of a very steep street in Alfama. You'll have the sofa bed in the living room, with a view over the river.

users.name: Tiago
users.about_me: I cook at a small tasca in Graça and I'm always happy to feed my guests. Markets, fado and long walks along the river are my favourite way to show off the city.
users.about_place: Shared apartment with a guest room and a kitchen you are welcome to use.

users.name: Amara
users.about_me: I study dolphins in the Tagus estuary and spend weekends surfing. Happy to host fellow ocean lovers and anyone who wants to try the best pastéis de nata in Arroios.
users.about_place: Bright guest room with its own desk, five minutes from the metro.

users.name: Jonas
users.about_me: Moved from Hamburg for the light and stayed for the people. I can lend you a bike, tell you which hills to avoid and where to find the best bifana in town.
users.about_place: Air mattress in the studio, bikes in the hallway.

users.name: Leila
users.about_me: I design homes and love talking about buildings, cities and food. Hosting has given me friends all over the world, and I always learn something from my guests.
users.about_place: Private room in a renovated warehouse flat near the LX Factory.

users.name: Rui
users.about_me: Musician, early riser and terrible at goodbyes. If you like music you're welcome at my Thursday jam sessions, and I'll happily point you to the best fado houses.
users.about_place: Spare room above a bakery in Campo de Ourique. Yes, it smells amazing.

users.name: Luan
users.about_me: Brazilian history student researching the Age of Discoveries, and happy to give an unofficial tour of Belém. I love meeting people from everywhere over a coffee and a pastel de nata.
users.about_place: Couch in a shared student flat. Lively, friendly and close to the river.

users.name: Kenji
users.about_me: Remote worker, amateur photographer and ramen perfectionist. I moved here two years ago and love meeting travelers from everywhere and exploring new neighbourhoods.
users.about_place: Guest room with a view of the Vasco da Gama bridge.

users.name: Marta
users.about_me: Across the river from Lisbon, ten minutes from the beach. I'll take you surfing if the waves are good and to my favourite seafood place in Cacilhas if they're not.
users.about_place: Small house with a garden and a hammock.

users.name: Daniel
users.about_me: Teacher by day, community organizer by weekend in Queens. I'm visiting Melbourne for a teaching conference and love meeting locals wherever I go, especially over good food.
users.about_place: Guest room in a family house, close to the 7 train.

users.name: Priya
users.about_me: Doctor working night shifts, morning runner around Princes Park and a regular at our language exchange. I host when my schedule allows and always have time for a coffee with travelers.
users.about_place: Couch in a sunny terrace house in Brunswick.

users.name: Omar
users.about_me: I photograph the city at sunrise along the Yarra and lead the occasional bike ride. Originally from Alexandria, so I'll always find the best falafel in the neighbourhood and cook for you if you let me.
users.about_place: Sofa bed in a warehouse apartment in Collingwood.

users.name: Zoë
users.about_me: Illustrator and barista who bakes far too much for our potlucks. I love sketching with guests in Carlton Gardens and showing them the laneways and street art of Fitzroy.
users.about_place: Air mattress and a lot of houseplants.

users.name: Felix
users.about_me: Recording engineer from Berlin, visiting New York for a music festival. When I'm home I host in Kreuzberg and love taking guests to small concerts and flea markets.
users.about_place: Couch in Kreuzberg, close to the canal.

users.name: Valeria
users.about_me: I write about street food and know every taquería in Roma Norte. Guests get a tour of the market, my abuela's mole recipe and a strong opinion on salsa verde versus salsa roja.
users.about_place: Guest room in a 1920s building with a little balcony full of plants.

users.name: Hana
users.about_me: Product designer from Seoul on my first big trip to Australia. I love coffee, design museums and long walks, and I host in Mapo whenever friends from Couchers come through.
users.about_place: Small apartment in Mapo with a floor mattress and a great view.

references.text: Inês is the kind of host who makes you feel like you've lived in Lisbon for years. She took me to a miradouro I'd never have found and her workshop is magical.
Warm, funny and a fantastic cook. The view from her living room is unreal. I can't wait to host her in Berlin.
One of the kindest people I know. Every guest leaves as a friend.
Super easy to communicate with and so generous with her time. A perfect first couch surfing experience.
Maya was a wonderful guest. Thoughtful, curious and she left the kitchen cleaner than she found it.
Maya is the heart of our Carlton meetups. Always the first to welcome new people.
Tiago cooked the best dinner of my trip and showed me fado in a tiny bar I'd never have found.
Generous, funny and always up for a long walk around the city.
Amara knows every beach around Lisbon and is the most thoughtful friend.
A wonderful person to explore the city with. Her enthusiasm is contagious.
Jonas fixed my bike and then took me on the best ride along the river.
Leila is warm, curious and a brilliant host. Her flat is beautiful.
Always welcoming and full of great recommendations.
Rui's Thursday sessions are the highlight of my week.
Kind, funny and a fantastic musician. A true Lisbon character.
Luan gave me the best history tour of Belém. So much knowledge and so much fun.
Kenji is thoughtful and easy-going, and makes incredible ramen.
A calm, kind host with a great sense of humour.
Marta took me surfing for the first time and I've been hooked ever since.
Her garden is a little paradise. Can't recommend her enough.

messages.author: maya_r
messages.text: Olá Inês! I'm visiting Lisbon for a design conference and would love to stay with you for a few nights. Your tile workshop sounds amazing, I'd love to hear how you restore azulejos. I'm tidy, cook a mean shakshuka and happy to fit around your schedule.

messages.author: ines_s
messages.text: Olá Maya! Those dates work perfectly. The sofa bed is yours 🙂 I'm at the workshop until 6 most days, but you're welcome to come by and see the tiles.

messages.author: maya_r
messages.text: Amazing, thank you! I land at 2pm on the first day. Is it ok if I drop my bag around 4?

messages.author: ines_s
messages.text: Of course. Take the 28 tram to Largo das Portas do Sol, my place is two minutes away. Tiago is also organising a sunset picnic while you're here, you should come!

messages.author: maya_r
messages.text: Yes please! Can't wait. Let me know if you'd like anything from Melbourne 🦘

messages.author: maya_r
messages.text: Hola Valeria! I'm heading to Mexico City after Lisbon and your food tours sound incredible. Could I stay with you for five nights?

messages.author: valeria_g
messages.text: ¡Hola Maya! Claro que sí. I'm running a taco walk that week, you're coming with me.

messages.author: maya_r
messages.text: I've been practising my Spanish just for this. ¡Gracias!

messages.author: hana_k
messages.text: Hi Maya! I'm visiting Melbourne for the design festival and your place looks lovely. Could I stay for three nights?

messages.author: maya_r
messages.text: Hi Hana! I'd love to have you. The couch is yours, the cat comes included.

messages.author: hana_k
messages.text: Thank you! I'll bring some snacks from Seoul for you (and treats for the cat).

messages.author: daniel_a
messages.text: Hi Maya, I'm in Melbourne for a teaching conference. Could I crash for two nights? Happy to cook dinner one evening.

messages.author: maya_r
messages.text: Sounds great Daniel, see you then! There's a potluck that weekend if you'd like to come.

messages.author: zoe_w
messages.text: Are you coming to the potluck? I'm making empanadas again 🥟

messages.author: maya_r
messages.text: Wouldn't miss it! I'll bring a salad and my famous lemon cake.

messages.author: priya_n
messages.text: Thanks for helping with the picnic sign-ups this week!

messages.author: maya_r
messages.text: Anytime! Want me to bring the frisbees?

events.title: Sunday picnic in Carlton Gardens
events.content: Bring a blanket, something to share and a friend. We'll be near the fountain, look for the orange flag! Everyone is welcome, including newcomers and travelers passing through.

events.title: Language exchange night
events.content: Practise Spanish, Italian, Korean, Arabic or anything else you're learning. Tables are grouped by language and we switch every 30 minutes.

events.title: Sunrise ride along the Yarra
events.content: An easy-paced ride along the river at sunrise, followed by coffee and pastries. Share bikes are fine!

events.title: Couchers potluck dinner
events.content: Our monthly potluck! Bring a dish from your home town or your last trip and the story behind it.

events.title: Day hike in the Dandenong Ranges
events.content: We'll take the train to Belgrave and walk the 1000 Steps and the forest trails. Moderate difficulty, bring water and good shoes.

events.title: Sunset picnic at Senhora do Monte
events.address: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte, Lisbon
events.content: The best view in Lisbon! Bring something to share and enjoy the sunset over the city with travelers and locals.

events.title: Taco walk in Roma Norte
events.content: A walking tour of my favourite taquerías and markets in Roma Norte. Come hungry!

discussions.creator: priya_n
discussions.title: Best spots to take first-time visitors?
discussions.content: I host a lot of first-time visitors and I'm always torn between the classics and somewhere more local. Where do you take your guests?

comments.author: luca_r
comments.text: The Royal Botanic Gardens at sunrise, then breakfast in Fitzroy. Works every time.

comments.author: zoe_w
comments.text: Hosier Lane for the street art, then a walk along the river to Southbank.

comments.author: maya_r
comments.text: I always take guests to Queen Victoria Market on a Saturday morning. Bring an empty stomach!

discussions.creator: luca_r
discussions.title: Free walking tours this month
discussions.content: Collecting the free walking tours happening around the city this month so we can share them with surfers. Add yours below!

comments.author: priya_n
comments.text: There's a free laneways tour every Sunday at 10am from the State Library.

comments.author: maya_r
comments.text: Adding the Carlton history walk on the 14th. I'll share the details here.

discussions.creator: zoe_w
discussions.title: Hosting tips for small apartments
discussions.content: My place is tiny but I love hosting. What are your best tricks for making guests comfortable when space is tight?

comments.author: maya_r
comments.text: A good room divider and a spare set of towels go a long way.

comments.author: priya_n
comments.text: I leave a little welcome note with the wifi password and my favourite cafes nearby.

comments.author: luca_r
comments.text: Earplugs and an eye mask by the couch. Guests always thank me for those.

comments.author: zoe_w
comments.text: These are great, thank you all! Trying the welcome note this weekend.
